invariants: Ownership and licensing terms must be stated explicitly before final handover
Customer-owned assets must not remain solely controlled by an LD staff account after handover
Secrets and credentials must never be transmitted in plaintext inside ordinary handover documents
Credential transfer requires a secure approved channel and post-transfer rotation where appropriate
Data export or portability evidence must exist before an exit is represented as complete
Third-party subscriptions and recurring provider obligations must be disclosed
LD access must be revoked or reduced according to the agreed post-handover support model
A completed handover must preserve an evidence manifest of what was transferred, retained, excluded and revoked
Customer acceptance of handover must be explicit
Unresolved ownership, export, credential or access-revocation issues keep handover in REVIEW or HOLD
